about: Inquiry-triage eval cases. Seeds are real inquiries Elle Jones received, anonymized (names, phones, emails, and neighborhoods changed; wording kept). Variations were written from the seeds. Expected answers were proposed by Claude and reviewed by Elle. The mix reflects Elle's studio-based business: mostly studio sessions, events only occasionally. All cases use today = 2026-09-24. A location of "any" means any answer is accepted (e.g. the client only says "your studio").

cases.message: Hi I'm looking for a photographer to shoot photos at my photo station for my party. On July 25th in NE Portland. Wish list includes 70-80 guests to take photos at station unlimited-ish. (Time provided) I'd like guest to walk away with one photo each printed with photographers on site printer and as the host I'd like a digital copy of all photos. Is this a service you can provide for a 4 hr party? If so can you provide an estimate and pay schedule?

replyChecks: Does not give a price, an estimate, or a payment schedule; says details will follow.

cases.message: Hello! I'd love to get studio family photos done the weekend before Thanksgiving so I can use them for our Christmas cards. It's me, my husband and our 3 kids (ages 2, 6 and 9). Do you have matching outfit suggestions? - Renee Alvarez

replyChecks: Does not promise the photos will be ready in time for Christmas cards.

cases.message: Good morning. I hope you are doing well today. I wanted to reach out, as I seen you comment on a post I made looking for a photographer for a maternity shoot. The father and I are not on good terms due to some very serious issues and I choose to not be around him do to safety reasons. I was wondering if I'd be able to replace the other parent (father) with my best friend instead? Thank you for your time

replyChecks: Warmly acknowledges her request to include her best friend.
Does not ask about or comment on the father or the situation with him.
